description: Scheduled Amazon Macie classification job has no recent execution evidence
rationale: A scheduled job's last run is older than the 45-day review window, or no last run is reported more than 45 days after creation. One-time jobs are excluded; a run does not itself prove classification success.
remediation: Review the job ID, run status/error, bucket definitions, schedule and S3/KMS access. The 45-day threshold is a ScoutSuite review heuristic, not a universal compliance requirement.
